summary: Turns a spreadsheet into one data asset per row, matching the header to field names.
overview: Point it at a CSV whose header row matches field names on a GameDataAsset subclass and it creates or updates one asset per row — fifty item stats becoming fifty balanced assets in a click rather than fifty hand edits.
useCases: Importing a designer's balance spreadsheet as item or enemy assets.
Re-importing after a balance pass, updating rather than duplicating.
Bulk-creating assets that would be tedious to make by hand.

gotchas.title: Header names must match the field names
gotchas.body: A column with no matching field is ignored silently. Check the first import carefully.

gotchas.title: It updates existing assets by id
gotchas.body: Which is what makes a re-import safe — and means changing an id in the sheet creates a new asset rather than renaming one.
